subject.title: [Bug]: Agent reads workspace files after tool discovery, causing timeouts on natural language queries

question: Should slow local-model first turns prioritize workspace bootstrap guidance such as TOOLS.md/SOUL.md before Tool Search, or should OpenClaw keep exposing Tool Search first and steer users through configuration/docs?
rationale: Current code and tests make Tool Search exposure intentional for local-model lean mode, while the issue asks for a different first-turn policy that could trade off prompt pressure, tool discoverability, and local-model reliability.

options.title: Define a workspace-first policy
options.body: Adopt a narrow rule for slow/local-model first turns that makes injected workspace guidance steer tool choice before Tool Search, with live Nemotron/vLLM proof and regression coverage.

options.title: Keep Tool Search-first and document tuning
options.body: Treat the current behavior as intentional, improve docs/doctor guidance for slow local backends, and ask reporters to use toolSearch or supportsTools configuration when needed.

options.title: Wait for live reproduction only
options.body: Defer policy changes until a maintainer or reporter reproduces the timeout on current main with redacted logs from a supported local-model setup.

recommendation.title: Define a workspace-first policy
recommendation.body: Adopt a narrow rule for slow/local-model first turns that makes injected workspace guidance steer tool choice before Tool Search, with live Nemotron/vLLM proof and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently changed the local-model lean Tool Search default path that would need policy adjustment or defense.
